name: Shelly Plug Gen4 (US)

radios.note: Shelly lists Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Zigbee, and says the plug can act as a Zigbee router. Matter runs over Wi-Fi per the CSA listing.

matter.note: CSA certificate CSA250D9MAT45099-24 (02/10/2025, firmware 1.3.0-s2, product ID 0x1852, Wi-Fi transport). The CSA description text mentions the Shelly 1PM Gen4, which looks like a copy error.

apple_home.note: Shelly says it works with Apple HomeKit through its Matter certification. Apple's own accessory list was not checked. Needs an Apple home hub for remote control and automations.

google_home.note: Shelly lists Google Smart Home (On/Off trait) without a device-specific page confirming its cloud link, so we only claim Matter. Needs a Google Matter controller.

alexa.note: Shelly lists Alexa (Power Controller) without a device-specific page confirming the Shelly Cloud skill, so we only claim Matter. Needs an Echo that works as a Matter controller.

smartthings.note: Shelly lists SmartThings (Switch, Power Meter) without saying whether that is a cloud link or Matter, so we only claim Matter. Needs a SmartThings Matter hub.

home_assistant.note: Official Shelly integration, which says it supports all four Shelly device generations. Matter and Zigbee are other routes.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device with Wi-Fi access-point setup; no bridge needed.

localControl.note: Shelly lists local control, locally stored schedules and local scripting; Home Assistant's Shelly integration talks to the device on the local network.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in power meter. It also has a light sensor for illuminance reporting.

maxLoadWatts.note: 15 A / 1800 W, with overheating, overvoltage, overcurrent and overpower protection.

summary: Matter over Wi-Fi connects the Shelly Plug Gen4 (US), model S4PL-00116US, to Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings, and Home Assistant picks it up locally through its official Shelly integration. It's CSA-certified, needs no hub, and also carries Bluetooth and Zigbee radios (it can act as a Zigbee router). Rated 15 A / 1800 W, it has a built-in power meter and keeps schedules and scripts on the device.
caveats: Apple Home needs a home hub for remote control and automations.
Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings are confirmed only through Matter, so you need a Matter-capable Echo, Google Matter controller or SmartThings Matter hub.
